standard_prerequisites.name: Tree conditions of the forcing used for WKL
standard_prerequisites.statement: In this section a condition is a pair (sigma, T) consisting of a finite binary string and an M-infinite tree, and an extension (tau, T_2) of (sigma, T_1) requires tau to extend sigma and the tree T_2 to be contained in T_1; the requirements to be satisfied are listed by the author at source lines 640-643.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the objects of the counted lemma, namely the condition (sigma, T_1), its extension and the compatible generics G and Y.

standard_prerequisites.name: Forcing a decided initial segment of the jump
standard_prerequisites.statement: A condition (tau, U) forces the k-th initial segment of the jump of G plus Y to equal a string sigma' when for every index e below the length of sigma' it forces the corresponding value to converge if sigma'(e) is one and to diverge if sigma'(e) is zero; the article records this at source line 663 and notes that the relation is Pi^0_1(Y).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the conclusion of the counted lemma, and the proof transfers the two cases of the definition to every generic compatible with the constructed extension.

standard_prerequisites.name: Definability classes and M-finiteness in the model
standard_prerequisites.statement: A set defined by a Pi^0_1(Y) formula is M-finite in the models considered, and Pi^0_1 sets of finite binary strings of a fixed length are M-finite, which is what allows a lexicographically minimal element to be selected; the article uses this throughout this section.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof forms the set W of candidate strings, argues that it is Pi^0_1(Y) and M-finite, and then selects its lexicographically minimal element.

core_obligations: Form the set W of all strings sigma' of length k such that the tree of strings rho in T_1 satisfying, for every index e where sigma'(e) is zero, that the functional with index e on rho plus Y diverges at e, is M-infinite (source line 671).

Observe that W is Pi^0_1(Y) and therefore M-finite, and that W is non-empty since the all-one string belongs to it; take sigma' in W lexicographically minimal and let T_3 be the corresponding tree (source line 673).

For each index e below k with sigma'(e) equal to one, use minimality of sigma' to see that only M-finitely many tau in T_3 have the functional diverging at e, so there is a level h_e beyond which it converges on every tau of T_3 at that level (source line 673).

Let h bound the M-finitely many levels h_e, and apply the extendible-node lemma to the M-infinite tree T_3 to find tau in T_3 of length h whose upward cone T_2 inside T_3 is again M-infinite (source line 673).

Verify the forcing claim for the extension (tau, T_2) by fixing e below k: if sigma'(e) is zero then the functional diverges on every tau in T_2 because T_2 is contained in T_3, so e is not in the jump for any compatible generic; if sigma'(e) is one then the choice of tau makes the functional converge at e, so e belongs to the jump (source lines 675-679).
Conclude that the extension forces the k-th initial segment of the jump to equal sigma', which is the statement of the counted lemma (source line 680).

proof_roadmap.step: Define the Pi^0_1(Y), hence M-finite and non-empty, set of candidate strings.
Take the lexicographically minimal candidate, bound the convergence levels, and pick an extendible node of that length.
Check the two cases of the forcing relation for the chosen extension and conclude.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:wkl-wf-forcing-jump（源 666-668 行，证明 670-680 行）：在 WKL 的树力迫下，任一条件 (σ,T_1) 都有 M-有限串 σ' 与扩展 (τ,T_2)≤(σ,T_1) 强制 (G⊕Y)' 的前 k 位等于 σ'。关键操作不是例行核验：作者先把候选串集合 W 定义成一个 Π^0_1(Y) 集合（即 M-有限），取其中字典序最小者 σ' 及对应树 T_3（671-673 行）；再由 σ' 的最小性把每个 σ'(e)=1 的指标处的收敛水平 h_e 统一到一个上界 h，然后用「M-无穷树必有任意长度的可延拓结点」这一引理（647-650 行）取出长度 h 的 τ 使其上锥 T_2 仍 M-无穷；最后按 σ'(e)=0/1 两类逐点验证力迫关系（675-679 行）。难点在于把最小性同时用于「排除发散」与「保证收敛」，并让新树保持 M-无穷；原文位置在证明的 671-673 行与 675-679 行。
